##


The Lore Behind Forsaken Roblox Characters


#


[The lore](https://forsaken2024.fandom.com/wiki/Lore) gives these **Forsaken Roblox characters** more than a set of abilities to play around with. Their relationships and backstories give fans a reason to care about what happens between matches. That is also why people look up Forsaken characters personalities and their connections when they want to write dialogue, build an OC, or figure out roleplaying settings.


###


c00lkidd x 007n7 — Found Family in a Horror Game


#


[007n7](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/007n7-lxp6mre2po5x) is Forsaken’s adoptive father figure: he raised[c00lkidd](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/c00lkidd-jece3zgyp7i7) after finding him abandoned, years before c00lkidd became an exploiter himself and one of Forsaken’s Killers. Fans lean hard into this found-family read, a Survivor and a Killer who are family first, roles second, and constantly bring this dynamic into fan art and headcanons.


###


Two Time x Azure: The Spawn Cult’s Fallout


#


[Two Time](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/two-time-bnb8pjq757is) ‘s story is closely tied to the Spawn Cult, and his respawn came from sacrificing his closest friend,[Azure](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/azure-e9was6r66bwj) , for a second life. Azure later returns as a Killer after being corrupted by the Spectre. This dark edge gives **roleplay Forsaken characters** more to work with than a simple hero-versus-Killer setup.


###


Shedletsky x 1x1x1x1: A Rivalry Born From One Act


#


[Shedletsky](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/shedletsky-jr2i7u8l8j6t) plays as a retired admin with a sword and a taste for fried chicken, but his lore has a darker edge:[1x1x1x1](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/1x1x1x1-du0krwvs5dty) is described as a physical manifestation of the hatred Shedletsky carried within himself, which makes their rivalry more personal than a straightforward grudge.


###


Guest 666 x Noob: A Friendship That Turned


#


[Guest 666](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/guest-666-pmaoauackqtm) grew increasingly competitive and aggressive as his relationship with[Noob](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/noob-2007-45iwnwoi4mw2) deteriorated, and the Spectre’s corruption later turned him into a Killer. It’s a smaller arc than Two Time and Azure’s, but the same shape: a friendship the game lets curdle into something else.

##


Most Popular Ships Among Forsaken Characters


#


This game’s lore also fuels the Roblox Forsaken fandom’s ships, including a mix of canon relationships and fan-favorite pairings:


- **Azuretime (Two Time x Azure)** : Two Time sacrificed his fellow Spawn Cult member and closest friend, Azure, for a second life, and fans keep writing the pair because the trust between them was real enough to make the betrayal land.
- **Guest 1337 x Daisy** : they grew up together in an orphanage after the Bacon Empire’s genocide, married, and had a daughter, Charlotte, the same soldier-protecting-his-own dynamic fans are already drawn to in his character.
- **John Doe x Jane Doe** : A classic canon couple in the community. They’re married employees before John’s corruption blocked him from recognizing her face, the tragedy built into the kill mechanic itself is what fans are hooked into.
- **Doublefedora (Chance x Mafioso)** : Chance used to be welcome at Mafioso’s family casino until he won big off a rigged game and ran, and the contrast of two fedora-wearing Robloxians now on opposite sides of a debt has driven shipping content.
- **BrightEyes x Shedletsky** : BrightEyes is based on a real former Roblox admin who was actually married to Shedletsky before his Forsaken counterpart was corrupted, and fans keep writing the reunion even though she isn’t a confirmed playable character yet.
- **Elliot x 007n7** : 007n7 and his adopted son c00lkidd are explicitly labeled as Elliot’s arch-enemies in the official lore, but the “rivals-to-lovers” dynamic between them and in-game interactions have drawn fan-made interpersonal dramas and creative edits or tags on[TikTok via #pizzaburgerforsaken](https://www.tiktok.com/@rody_760/video/7480012785431104786) .


These relationships and character archetypes give the cast material that fans can take beyond the game itself: Fan art, headcanons, fan content like Forsaken oc x canon fic, Forsaken Roblox roleplay games, all have room to build on details that the game only establishes in brief pieces.

##


FAQ


#


###


**Does Forsaken have a roleplay mode?**


#


Not officially — matches are timed Survivor-vs-Killer rounds. That’s why so much Forsaken Roblox roleplay happens outside the game: Discord servers, fan-made spinoffs, dedicated Forsaken roleplay game on Roblox or[other AI-assisted character platforms](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/ai-roleplay-games-with-characters) (roleplay Forsaken characters).


###


**Why do Roblox Asym characters get so much roleplay and fan fiction?**


#


Roblox’s ssymmetric horror (“Asym”) games gave their casts real backstories and archetypes, not just gameplay roles, Forsaken Roblox characters included. That’s why pairing them up like Two Time x Azure, Elliot x 007n7, Forsaken character x OC, or writing forsaken x reader stories, is such a common way to spend more time with a cast the game moves on from.


###


**Where can I roleplay with favorite characters outside Forsaken?**


#


Fan-made Roblox spinoffs like[Forsaken Roleplay](https://www.roblox.com/games/114480507411347/Forsaken-Roleplay) and[Forsaken RP](https://www.roblox.com/games/76231371152392/Forsaken-RP) let you play as Survivor or Killer, and dozens of fan communities run dedicated Forsaken RP threads. AI-assisted character and story apps are another option, but most keep you in one chat window with one character at a time. If you want all favorite Forsaken characters (and your OC) to gather in one place, and talk to c00lkidd or Elliot with the plot you write yourself, Redbean help create your own game world to roleplay Forsaken characters you already love.


###


**Which ships are actually 100% canon in the lore?**


#


By the game’s own lore: *John Doe x Jane Doe* and *Guest 1337 x Daisy* are all canon relationships. *BrightEyes x Shedletsky* is grounded in the real people they’re based on, but BrightEyes herself isn’t a confirmed playable character yet. Azuretime ( *Two Time x Azure* ) is canon too, but predates their time trapped in Forsaken. “Double Fedora” ( *Chance x Mafioso* ) or “Paycheck” ( *Chance x Elliot* ) remain fan-built despite a massive popularity across social platforms, as the game never confirms them romantically.
